query: how to automate weekly reports by email
title: How to automate weekly reports by email | 50agents
description: Automate a weekly report email: fix the window to last Monday to Sunday in your timezone, compare with the week before, and make empty weeks say so.
h1: How to automate weekly reports by email
answer: Pick three to five numbers, fix the window (last Monday 00:00 to Sunday 23:59 in your timezone), and schedule a tool to read the source every Monday morning, compare with the week before, and email the result.
A report that says "0" because the data was late, or never arrives because a step failed, is worse than none, so make it say when something is missing.

sections.h2: Decide four things before you build

head: Decide
Good answer
Why it matters
rows: The numbers
3 to 5, each one you would act on
A report with 20 numbers gets skimmed, then ignored.
The window
Monday 00:00 to Sunday 23:59, your timezone
"Last 7 days" run at 9:00 on Monday includes Monday morning and cuts last Monday morning.
The comparison
The week before, and the same week last year if seasonal
A number alone tells you nothing; a change does.
The words
One line on what changed and why, if known
This is what an AI step adds over a dashboard.

method.h2: How to set it up, step by step

steps.title: Write the report by hand once
steps.body: Open the source, pull last week’s numbers, write the email you would want. That email is your spec.

steps.title: Fix the window in words
steps.body: "Payments from last Monday 00:00 to Sunday 23:59, Europe/London". Put the timezone in the report itself.

steps.title: Schedule it after the data settles
steps.body: If payouts or ad spend arrive overnight, send at 9:00, not 0:05.

steps.title: Make empty and failed weeks visible
steps.body: If a source returns nothing, the email should say "no payments found between X and Y", not "$0". If a step fails, you should hear about it the same morning.

steps.title: Send to yourself for two weeks
steps.body: Check it against the source by hand. Then add the team.

body: In 50agents this is an AI agent: it reads, compares and writes the summary in words each Monday. Captain plans it from one sentence; you see the plan, including when it runs and what asks you first, before it is built.
The same pattern works for any source Captain can reach through 2,300+ apps: HubSpot deals won, Shopify orders, support tickets closed. Say the numbers you want in the sentence.

wrong.title: The report says $0
wrong.body: The data was late or the search found nothing. Make the report say what it searched and that it found nothing, not a zero.

wrong.title: The window is off by a day
wrong.body: "Last 7 days" counted from the send time. Use calendar weeks in your timezone.

wrong.title: It moved an hour in March
wrong.body: Daylight saving shifted a schedule set in UTC. Set the schedule in your own timezone.

wrong.title: It failed and nobody noticed
wrong.body: A connection expired and the report simply stopped. Pick a tool that tells you about failed runs, and notice the Monday it does not arrive.

wrong.title: The person who built it left
wrong.body: The schedule ran from their account. Build reports on a shared account or document who owns them.

faqs.q: Can Google Sheets email a report on a schedule?
faqs.a: Not by itself. Apps Script can, with a time trigger and a little code, or an automation tool can read the sheet and send the email.

faqs.q: Can Looker Studio email a report weekly?
faqs.a: Yes. Scheduled delivery sends a PDF and a link to up to 50 recipients; free schedules can run at most daily.

faqs.q: What timezone does a scheduled report use?
faqs.a: It depends on the tool: Looker Studio uses your computer’s timezone, Zapier uses the account’s. Always check, and print the window in the report.
